verdict.rationale: Docs describe a Copilot cloud agent that can autonomously plan, explore, execute, and even run on a schedule/events, with isolated sandboxes for safe execution, then let users track progress, review diffs, and merge completed work for review (docs-3, docs-6, docs-8, docs-14, docs-15, docs-16). This matches build/test/execute-then-review end-to-end workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the cloud agent's testing/demo capability specifically (community evidence only covers inline/chat Copilot, not the cloud agent), and no explicit mention of automated test execution or demo artifact generation.
